# graph-manager server: cache each live run's view model so finished runs keep their details (GMD-14)

## What to build

graph-manager's run detail page needs per-task elapsed times, line counts (+N −N), attempts, review/fix phase results and failure reasons for **finished** runs. The engine keeps them only in memory and serves them from the live run page at `GET <run page url>/state` (a JSON snapshot of its view model). They are lost once that page closes. **The engine package must not be changed** (`packages/graph-execution/` is off limits for this whole run; only read it).

So graph-manager snapshots the view itself:

- A background **view cache** in the graph-manager server polls every live run.
- "Live" means a run whose page server is up: `livePage(runDir)` in `src/server/runs.ts` returns `{url, pid}`.
- Every 3 s it fetches `<url>state` directly (it is on 127.0.0.1) and saves a compact copy to `<GM_DATA_DIR>/views/<workspaceId>/<runId>.json`.
- The run page stays up after the run ends, until the user presses Close, so the cache normally captures the final summary too.
- Expose `readCachedView(dataDir, workspaceId, runId)` for the runs routes.

For runs that finished while graph-manager was not running, there is no cache. Other tasks fall back to `state.json` and git, so make sure `readCachedView` just returns undefined then.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `packages/graph-execution/src/web/server.ts` (READ ONLY), `snapshot()` near line 138: `GET /state` returns `{ ...ViewState, graph: {nodes:[{id,title,view}], layers, parents}, runId, provider, mergeTarget, startedAt, humanReview, fatal?, summaryContent? }`.
  - The server answers 421 unless the `Host` header is `127.0.0.1:<port>` or `localhost:<port>`. Node's `fetch("http://127.0.0.1:<port>/state")` sends exactly that.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/ui/store.ts` (READ ONLY):
  - lines 20–56: `NodeView` (status, attempt, attempts, label, round, rounds, changes?: NodeChanges, testPlan?, startedAt?/endedAt? in epoch ms, loops, lastLoop)
  - lines 82–115: `ViewState` (nodes, agents {gateFixer, reviewer, tester, fixer}, gate, merge, phase, summary?, events, retryable, mergeable, review?, failures)
  - These types are exported from `graph-execution/api` as `NodeView`, `ViewState`. Use them for typing the fetched JSON, but validate with zod (tolerant, `.passthrough()`), because the page may change.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/runner/events.ts` (READ ONLY): `PhaseChange`, `NodeChanges` (`total: {added, deleted, files}`), `RunEnd` (exitCode, reports, fixPasses, abort?, merge?: TargetMerge {target, ok, reason?}).
- `packages/graph-execution/src/review/report.ts` (READ ONLY, line ~58): `Report`. Count its findings for the summary.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runs.ts`:
  - `livePage(runDir)` (line 58)
  - `listRuns(workspacesDir)` (line 128), which returns `RunSummary[]` with `workspaceId`, `id`, `live`
  - `runDirOf(ws, runId)` (line 227)
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/app.ts`: `buildApp` creates the context and registers `onClose` hooks (line 70: `app.addHook("onClose", async () => terminals.disposeAll())`). Start the cache's timer here and stop it on close. `BuildAppOptions` gets `viewCache?: false` so tests can turn it off; leave it on by default.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/store.ts`: the atomic write pattern (tmp + rename) to mirror.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runs.test.ts`, `src/server/test-helpers.ts`: test patterns (temp dirs, `testConfig`).

## Step-by-step tasks

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/viewcache.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - The types (graph-manager's own, not the engine's):
  ```ts
  export type CachedNode = { status: string; attempt?: number; attempts?: number; startedAt?: number; endedAt?: number;
    added?: number; deleted?: number; files?: number; round?: number; rounds?: number; error?: string };
  export type CachedView = {
    version: 1; runId: string; savedAt: string; final: boolean;          // final: summary present
    phase: { phase: string; round?: number; fixPasses?: number; humanRound?: number };
    nodes: Record<string, CachedNode>;
    agents: Partial<Record<"gateFixer" | "reviewer" | "tester" | "fixer", CachedNode>>;
    gate?: CachedNode; merge?: CachedNode;
    review?: { round: number; blocking: number; decision?: string };
    summary?: { exitCode: number; fixPasses: number; findings: number; abort?: { step: string; message: string };
                merge?: { target: string; ok: boolean; reason?: string } };
    testPlan?: { cases: number; pass: number; fail: number; blocked: number };
  };
  ```
  - `toCachedView(snapshot: unknown): CachedView | undefined`: a pure function.
    - Never store `events`, file lists or `summaryContent`.
    - `added`/`deleted`/`files` come from `changes.total`.
    - `error` comes from `failures[id].error`, truncated to 500 chars.
    - Findings are summed over `summary.reports`. Look at the `Report` shape for where findings are.
  - `viewPath(dataDir, wsId, runId)`: validate both ids. `wsId` matches `^[A-Za-z0-9._~-]+$`; `runId` uses `RUN_ID_PATTERN` from `graph-execution/api` or `isRunId` from `runs.ts`.
  - `readCachedView(dataDir, wsId, runId): Promise<CachedView | undefined>`: tolerant.
  - `class ViewCache { constructor(opts: { dataDir; workspacesDir; intervalMs?: number; fetch?: typeof fetch }); start(); stop(); tick(): Promise<void> }`.
    - Each tick lists the live runs: `listRuns(workspacesDir).filter(r => r.live && r.type === "run")`.
    - For each, it fetches `livePage(runDirOf(...)).url + "state"` with a 2 s timeout (`AbortSignal.timeout`) and writes the compact view atomically.
    - It skips the write when the content is unchanged.
    - Ticks never overlap, and errors are swallowed.
- **GOTCHA**: the `url` in `web.json` ends with `/`.
- **GOTCHA**: a page in human review or any phase still returns a valid snapshot.

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/app.ts`

- Create `new ViewCache({ dataDir: config.dataDir, workspacesDir: config.workspacesDir })`, `start()` it unless `opts.viewCache === false`, and `stop()` it in an `onClose` hook.
- Add `viewCache` to `AppContext` (optional field).
- Keep the edit to a few lines.

### ADD `apps/graph-manager/src/server/viewcache.test.ts`

- `toCachedView` on a hand-built snapshot: it keeps statuses, times, totals and findings, and drops events.
- An invalid input gives undefined.
- A `tick()` against a tiny local `http` server that answers `/state` with a snapshot, with a fake run folder whose `web.json` holds `{url, pid: process.pid}`, writes the file. A second identical tick doesn't rewrite it (check the mtime).
- `readCachedView` on a missing file gives undefined.
- A bad id is rejected.

### UPDATE docs

- `apps/graph-manager/README.md`: one line under Configuration or the data dir description: `<GM_DATA_DIR>/views/` keeps a snapshot of each run's view while its page is live, so finished runs keep task times, line counts and review results.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Start graph-manager, then in a cloned workspace with the engine's diamond fixture committed run `graph-execution diamond --spec spec.md --provider fake --web` (see `TESTING.md`). Within a few seconds `<GM_DATA_DIR>/views/<wsId>/<runId>.json` exists. After the run ends (before pressing Close) it has `final: true`, 4 nodes `merged` with `startedAt`/`endedAt`, and `summary.exitCode: 0`.
- [ ] Nothing under `packages/graph-execution/` is modified (`git diff --stat -- packages/graph-execution` is empty).
- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test -w graph-manager` pass, and no test leaves a timer running (tests that build the app pass `viewCache: false` or rely on `onClose`).

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test -w graph-manager -- viewcache
git diff --stat -- packages/graph-execution   # must be empty
```

---

## Shared context (same in every task of this run)

**Hard rule: client changes only.** Never modify anything under `packages/graph-execution/` (the engine). Read it, import from `graph-execution/api`, and run its CLI, but all changes go in `apps/graph-manager/` and docs (`TESTING.md`, `docs/`).

**Repo.** npm-workspaces monorepo. The engine is `packages/graph-execution` (published CLI, library entry `graph-execution/api` = `packages/graph-execution/src/api.ts`). The product is `apps/graph-manager`: Fastify 5 server in `src/server/`, React 19 + react-router 7 + Vite UI in `src/web/`, tests with vitest (server: `fastify.inject` via `src/server/test-helpers.ts`; UI: `// @vitest-environment jsdom` + `@testing-library/react` with `fetch` stubbed by `vi.stubGlobal`, see `src/web/App.test.tsx`). The spec is `docs/prd/graph-manager-design.md`.

**The design.** `docs/design/graph-manager/` holds every board of the design as `NN-name.png` (screenshot, open it with your image-reading tool and LOOK at it), `NN-name.txt` (all its text) and `NN-name.html` (its real HTML/CSS, fonts stripped; copy measurements, colors and structure from here). Boards: `00-ia-proposal-react-notes`, `01-design-system`, `02-component-nav-rail`, `03-login-light`, `04-login-dark`, `05-runs-dashboard-light-start-run-open`, `06-runs-dashboard-dark`, `07-terminals-light-2-2-split`, `08-terminals-dark`, `09-terminals-800-px`, `10-run-detail-live-light`, `11-run-detail-live-dark`, `12-run-detail-finished-800-px`, `13-run-detail-landed-create-pr-light`, `14-run-detail-landed-create-pr-dark`, `15-workspaces-clone-light`, `16-workspaces-clone-dark`, `17-settings-forges-light`, `18-settings-forges-dark`, `19-empty-loading-error-dialogs-light`, `20-empty-loading-error-dialogs-dark`. Mock data in the boards (octo/hello, dev-vm-01, counts) is illustrative: show real data from the API. Where a board shows something impossible with real data, keep the layout and use real values.

**Shared UI contracts.** Tasks run in parallel, so everyone uses these exact names. Task 2 creates the `ui/` kit, task 3 creates the shell, overview and keys; later tasks only consume them (and may add optional fields to shared types in place).

- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/ui/tokens.css`: CSS variables `--bg --sf --sf2 --bd --bd2 --fg --fg2 --fg3 --ac --acbg --term --termfg` (values from `01-design-system`), status tones `--live --live-bg --ok --ok-bg --warn --warn-bg --bad --bad-bg --mute --mute-bg --rev --rev-bg`, `--space-1`…`--space-8` (4 8 12 16 20 24 32 48 px), `--radius-sm/md/lg` (4/6/10), `--control-h` 36px, `--control-h-dense` 32px, `--row-h` 40px, `--nav-w` 232px, `--rail-w` 56px, `--dur-fast` 120ms, `--dur-base` 180ms, `--font-sans` (Geist Variable, system-ui…), `--font-mono` (Geist Mono Variable, ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas). Light on `:root`, dark on `:root[data-theme="dark"]`. Components use only `var(--…)`, never hex.
- `ui/base.css` (imported once in `main.tsx`): global classes `.btn` (+ `.btn-primary`, `.btn-danger`, `.btn-ghost`, `.btn-sm`), `.input`, `.select`, `.textarea`, `.field` (`.field-label`, `.field-hint`, `.field-error`), `.card`, `.table` with `.table-row` / `.table-row.focused` / `.table-group`, `.chip`, `.mono`, `.num` (tabular-nums), `.muted`, `.page`, `.page-header`. Focus ring: 2px `var(--ac)` outline, 2px offset, on every focusable element.
- `ui/status.ts`: `type Tone = "live" | "ok" | "warn" | "bad" | "mute" | "rev"`, `type Glyph = "pulse" | "dot" | "ring" | "dashed" | "diamond" | "bar" | "half"`, `toneOf(kind: "run" | "task" | "term", value: string, exitCode?: number): Tone`, `glyphOf(kind, value, exitCode?): Glyph`. Mapping: run running→live/pulse, applied→ok/dot, done→mute/ring, aborted→mute/bar, failed→bad/diamond, review→rev/half; task running|validating|merging→live/pulse, merged→ok/dot, failed→bad/diamond, pending→mute/dashed; term working→live/pulse, idle→warn/half, exited with 0→mute/ring, exited with ≠0→bad/diamond.
- `ui/StatusBadge.tsx`: `<StatusBadge kind="run"|"task"|"term" value={string} exitCode?={number} label?={string} />` renders `<span className="badge tone-<tone>" data-tone=<tone>>` with the glyph and `label ?? value` (term exited shows `exited <code>`). Also exports `<StatusGlyph tone glyph />` and `<LiveDot />` (blue pulsing dot + "live").
- `ui/Icon.tsx`: `<Icon name=… size?={16} />`, inline SVG, `currentColor`. Names: `logo runs terminal folder settings search plus close external moon sun monitor logout chevron-left chevron-right chevron-down branch maximize layout-1 layout-2 layout-4 info git refresh`.
- `ui/Drawer.tsx`: `<Drawer open title onClose footer?>` right-side panel (360px; full width under 900px), Esc closes, focus goes back to the opener.
- `ui/Dialog.tsx`: `<ConfirmDialog open title body confirmLabel cancelLabel? tone?: "danger" | "primary" onConfirm onCancel extraAction?: {label, onClick} />` (role `dialog`, Esc = cancel, shows `Esc` kbd on Cancel).
- `ui/Segmented.tsx`: `<Segmented options={{value, label}[]} value onChange ariaLabel />` (role `radiogroup`, buttons role `radio`).
- `ui/Kbd.tsx` `<Kbd>Ctrl K</Kbd>`; `ui/ForgeChip.tsx` `<ForgeChip forge="github"|"gitlab" />` (mono caps chip GITHUB/GITLAB); `ui/Skeleton.tsx` `<SkeletonRows rows={4} />`; `ui/EmptyState.tsx` `<EmptyState title body? action? />`; `ui/Progress.tsx` `<Progress value={0..1} tone={Tone} />`.
- `ui/toast.tsx`: `<ToastProvider>` and `useToast(): { show(t: { tone: "ok" | "bad" | "live"; text: string; action?: { label: string; to?: string; onClick?: () => void } }): void }`. Bottom-right stack, auto-dismiss after 6 s.
- `ui/theme.ts`: `type ThemePref = "system" | "light" | "dark"`, `getThemePref()`, `setThemePref(p)` (`localStorage["gm.theme"]`, every access in try/catch), `applyTheme()` (sets `document.documentElement.dataset.theme` to the resolved `light`/`dark`, follows `matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)")` while `system`), `useTheme(): { pref, setPref, resolved }`.
- `src/web/types.ts`: the client copies of the API shapes: `RunSummary`, `TerminalInfo`, `WorkspaceEntry`, `ForgesInfo`. Add optional fields in place when your task adds them on the server.
- `src/web/overview.tsx`: `<OverviewProvider>` and `useOverview(): { runs: RunSummary[]; terminals: TerminalInfo[]; workspaces: WorkspaceEntry[]; workspacesRoot?: string; forges: ForgesInfo; loaded: boolean; updatedAt?: number; failures: number; stale: boolean; refresh(): Promise<void> }`. It polls `GET /api/runs`, `/api/terminals`, `/api/workspaces`, `/api/forges` every 2 s with `Promise.allSettled`, pauses while `document.hidden`, keeps the last good data, and sets `stale` after 3 failed polls in a row. Also `<UpdatedAgo />` ("updated 1s ago", amber when stale) and `<StaleBanner />` ("Can't reach the server. Showing data from 14s ago. Retrying…").
- `src/web/keys.ts`: `useKey(combo, handler, opts?: { enabled?: boolean; allowInInput?: boolean })` with combos like `"s"`, `"p"`, `"/"`, `"Escape"`, `"Ctrl+k"`, `"Ctrl+Enter"`; `isTypingTarget(el)` (input, textarea, select, contenteditable, or inside `.xterm`); `useListNav(count, { onOpen(i) }): [index, setIndex]` (j/k/Enter, ignored while typing). The shell handles `g r|t|w|s`, `Ctrl+k`, and `/` (focuses the first `[data-filter]` element on the page).
- Routes and query strings: `/runs?status=failed|live|ready&workspace=<id>`, `/runs/:ws/:runId`, `/terminals?workspace=<id>` (opens a new terminal there), `?focus=<terminalId>`, `?filter=working|idle|other`, `?run=<ws>/<runId>` (opens that run in a pane), `/workspaces?clone=1` (opens the clone drawer), `/settings`. Page roots keep `data-testid="page-runs" | "page-terminals" | "page-workspaces" | "page-settings" | "page-run-detail" | "page-login"`.
- Each page keeps its CSS in its own file next to it (`pages/Runs.css` imported by `pages/Runs.tsx`), so parallel tasks don't edit one stylesheet.

**Look at what you build.** For any UI change, build and run graph-manager and look at it in a real browser with `agent-browser` (installed globally; run `agent-browser skills get core` once if you need its command reference):

```bash
npm run build -w graph-execution && npm run build -w graph-manager
GM_DIR=$(mktemp -d)
node apps/graph-manager/scripts/fake-forge.mjs 7421 $GM_DIR/forge &      # fake GitHub/GitLab; tokens gh-good / gl-good
GM_PASSWORD=pw GM_PORT=7420 GM_DATA_DIR=$GM_DIR/data GM_WORKSPACES_DIR=$GM_DIR/ws \
  GM_GITHUB_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:7421/github node apps/graph-manager/dist/server/main.js &
agent-browser open http://127.0.0.1:7420/ && agent-browser snapshot -i
agent-browser set viewport 1440 900 && agent-browser screenshot /tmp/gm.png   # then open /tmp/gm.png and compare it with the board
```

Use another port if 7420/7421 are taken. Log in with `pw`. Check light and dark (`agent-browser eval 'document.documentElement.dataset.theme'`). Start runs with `--provider fake` only, never a real provider. Stop the servers by PID (`kill <pid>`), never by name. More recipes are in the graph-manager section of `TESTING.md`.

**Validation.**

```bash
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npm test -w graph-manager
git diff --stat -- packages/graph-execution     # must be empty: the engine is read-only for this run
```

Known environment failure: `packages/graph-execution/src/cli.test.ts` "exits 2 at startup when --provider claude is not on the PATH" fails wherever a real `claude` is installed next to `node`. Ignore that one case only.
